blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The municipal government of Bulalacao in Oriental Mindoro has suspended face-to-face classes in seven schools starting Thursday, following a reported armed encounter between the Army and an armed group in parts of the town. In Memorandum Order No. 10-289, series of 2026, dated Oct. 14, Mayor Lumelito M. Cabagay ordered the suspension of in-person classes and the implementation of modular distance learning (MDL) until further notice to protect learners, teachers, and other school personnel. The affected schools are San Roque Elementary School, Agong Elementary School, Gatol Elementary School, Balditan Elementary School, Abintang Elementary School, San Roque […]...
